decisions.anchor: the reliability and trustworthiness of long-running autonomous agent systems
decisions.reason: whether a governed self-improvement loop improves outcomes | notary-gated retrospective loop, pre-registered 880 PRs on two repos, 55/89 rules admitted but no held-out gain; sparse signal 0.45 comments/PR
sample efficiency of RL via LLM-generated demonstrations | DQN warmstart from LLM advice with value warmstart, perturbed sub-skills still accelerate learning; not LLM post-training dynamics

multi-trigger backdoor detection at inference | spectral subspace filtering, attack success 94.2-99.8%->2.07% on AlexNet/ResNet18/VGG16/MobileNetV2/ViT; software backdoor attack, not hardware-induced SDC

why ReLU units die after a frozen random encoder | input-offset ratio formula within 25% in all 44 cases, Pong live units 3-6/64->59-63; small-network study, dead units are not a named training-run pathology
